fundamental.summary: TJX shows no insider buying conviction, no institutional accumulation signal, zero government contracts, no lobbying activity, minimal retail interest, and elevated earnings risk within 61 days—fundamentals lack bullish catalysts.

sentiment.summary: Mixed signals: Congressional activity is minimal and non-directional; broad market fear (36 Fear/Greed score, 52% bearish AAII) presents contrarian opportunity, but lack of recent news data and insider conviction limits actionability.

risk.summary: Severe macro headwinds: inverted yield curve signals recession risk, VIX at crisis levels (229.6) indicates extreme market fear, and Consumer Discretionary sector faces demand destruction in recessionary environment; earnings in 61 days adds event risk but is not imminent.

debate.key_bull_argument: Structural uptrend alignment (EMA/SMA/Ichimoku/Supertrend bullish) with price near support (74.31) offers technical setup for mean-reversion in fear-driven market.
debate.key_bear_argument: Complete absence of momentum confirmation (MACD, PPO, OBV, Force Index all negative), suppressed volume (0.41 ratio), neutral RSI/Stoch, and severe macro headwinds (inverted yield curve, VIX crisis, recession risk) make entry probability too low despite technical structure.
